title: October 2026
serviceIntro: We help Davis Window & Door keep its website clear, useful and easy to find through technical SEO, answer engine optimization (AEO) and ongoing maintenance. Our work supports service content, site navigation and technical improvements so customers and search tools can understand the business.
monthlyRecap: October focused on launching the redesigned Windows page and making it easier for customers to request a consultation. We implemented the approved Atlanta-focused content, corrected the starting price to $2,000, refined the layouts across devices and improved the product images and search metadata. The approved page is now live at its existing address.
We also repaired website email sending, improved the contact form and confirmation message, and upgraded the site to PHP 8.3. Review rounds with Fee helped bring the page through approval and launch.

recap: Davis achieved a 100/100 on-page SEO score in the October 27 audit, with zero SEO issues reported and no broken pages. The long page title flagged in the earlier audit is no longer listed as an issue.

newContent.reportHtml:
The approved Windows page is live with the revised content, product images and consultation options.

Tracking: The requested GTM snippets were installed, then removed by HeyTony after they confirmed the request had been sent in error. This is not a completed conversion-tracking setup.

PHP security: The PHP 8.3 upgrade and installation of the specific security patches are confirmed complete.

nextSteps: In November, we’ll build on the Windows page launch with continued website, form and technical SEO checks. The priorities below are planned work.
